explanation: In English draughts, ordinary pieces, called men, move and capture only forwards. In international draughts, played on a 10 by 10 board, kings can also fly any distance along a diagonal.

claims.text: In English draughts, a king can move and capture backwards as well as forwards.
In English draughts, kings cannot move sideways, jump their own pieces or move more than one square along a diagonal except when capturing.
In English draughts, men move and capture only forwards.
In international draughts, played on a 10 by 10 board, kings can move any distance along a diagonal.
